card.name: Just before lactic or ketoacidosis terms
card.fires_on: Words right before an acidosis term is expected, such as the l of lactic, or 'including' after 'metabolic acidosis,' leading into diabetic ketoacidosis. Seen in metformin and SGLT2 inhibitor label text.

modes.label: Before lactic acidosis
modes.description: The first letter or linking word just before 'lactic acidosis' in metformin warnings.

modes.label: Before ketoacidosis
modes.description: The word 'including' after 'metabolic acidosis,' that leads into diabetic ketoacidosis.

modes.label: Inside eGFR values
modes.description: Pieces of eGFR or its number in kidney-function cutoffs in metformin labels.

card.writes: It pushes toward acid-related word starts like lact, acet and ket, which fit lactic acidosis and ketoacidosis.
card.plain: It fires when the text is about to name lactic acidosis or ketoacidosis in metformin-type labels.
